jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Trading
jobs.descriptionHtml:
3Commas.io is a leading SaaS of cryptocurrency trading since 2017, building the leading automation platform for crypto trading and turning complex markets into simple yet powerful algorithmic strategies.

Our AI-driven bots (DCA, Grid, Signal), deep integrations with TradingView, and a robust API enable traders to automate and optimize across 15+ major exchanges, including Binance, Coinbase, OKX, and Bybit. We serve a global community of individual and institutional traders and developers who rely on our security-first, reliable, and battle-tested infrastructure to run strategies 24/7.

Role Overview

3Commas is hiring a Product Manager to focus primarily on QuantPilot.com, our next-generation AI-powered trading platform launching in June 2026.

This is not a traditional PM role.

We are looking for someone who combines real trading experience with hands-on product execution. You will own the trading-facing surfaces in QuantPilot, drive the activation funnel, and help shape the product into something traders actually want to use.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You sit as a peer alongside other PMs and Product Designers, with each person owning their product areas. You report directly to the Chief Product / Growth Officer.

 

What You’ll Own

  • Trading-facing product areas in QuantPilot. Define how users use AI to discover, configure, and monitor trading strategies. Apply your trading background to make sure the product works for real traders.

  • The signup-to-trading activation funnel across QuantPilot. Identify and remove friction, drive activation and conversion metrics upward.

  • UX and user flows for key QuantPilot surfaces. Push for simpler onboarding, clearer strategy presentation, and better activation from signup to first trade.

  • Contributions to product discussions on new trading features, ideas, and verticals. Evaluate product decisions through a growth and revenue lens.

  • The user migration journey from legacy product to QuantPilot. Map out the transition path for users with active bots, exchange connections, and trading setups.

  • Close partnership with the Senior Product Designer on UX flows, trading-specific design patterns, and activation improvements.

  • Coordination with other PMs. Challenge feature ideas, UX decisions, push for simpler flows, and flag where the product is being built for power users at the expense of retail adoption.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Real trading experience. You have been a power user of trading platforms (crypto or RWA) and you understand the complexities of such interfaces and what traders want and need

  • 4+ years of product management experience, ideally on a B2C or prosumer trading product.

  • High ownership mindset. You are comfortable owning a domain end to end without waiting for direction.

  • Proven experience scaling and streamlining product management with AI automations (integrating Figma, Notion, Jira, Github, Amplitude into AI PM workflows)

  • Strong execution mindset. You ship quickly, iterate based on user feedback, and prioritise outcomes over outputs.

  • Activation and growth thinking. You have driven funnel metrics upwards in a previous role and can talk through how.

  • Strong UX intuition. You can spot friction before users complain about it and push for simpler flows over more features.

  • Ability to work independently in an early-stage environment with ambiguity.

  • Strong written and verbal English.

  • High ownership mindset. You are comfortable owning a domain end to end without waiting for direction.

 

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience with trading scripting languages like PineScript

  • Past experience working as a developer.

  • Direct experience with crypto trading platforms, exchanges, or trading tools

  • Knowledge/understanding about vibe trading tools (chat-to-strategy-to-trade)

  • Background in launching or growing a 0 to 1 trading product

  • Familiarity with AI-driven product surfaces and prompt-based interfaces

 

Why Join 3Commas?

🔧 Build at Massive Scale

Work on products used by millions of crypto traders worldwide.

🚀 Own a Category-Defining Launch

QuantPilot is one of the most ambitious AI-native trading products we’ve built. You will directly shape how it enters the market.

🧠 Fast-Moving Team

Join a highly execution-oriented team where strong ideas and ownership matter more than hierarchy.

🌍 Global & Remote

Work remotely or from our hubs in Cyprus, Tallinn, or Barcelona.

 

Equal Opportunity Statement

3Commas is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse perspectives build stronger teams, products, and communities.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

jobs.title: Crypto Marketing Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
3Commas.io is a leading SaaS of cryptocurrency trading since 2017, building the leading automation platform for crypto trading and turning complex markets into simple yet powerful algorithmic strategies.

Our AI-driven bots (DCA, Grid, Signal), deep integrations with TradingView, and a robust API enable traders to automate and optimize across 15+ major exchanges, including Binance, Coinbase, OKX, and Bybit. We serve a global community of individual and institutional traders and developers who rely on our security-first, reliable, and battle-tested infrastructure to run strategies 24/7.

Role Overview

3Commas is looking for a strong Marketing Lead to own the go-to-market execution for QuantPilot.com, our new agentic AI trading platform.

We want a true player who can take full ownership, move fast, and drive real momentum from day one.

What you'll own

  • Complete ownership of the marketing launch for QuantPilot.com

  • Bringing fresh ideas on what actually works in crypto marketing right now, not just executing a playbook

  • Building and activating the community, especially on Crypto Twitter, so people are actually talking about the product

  • Creating and executing the full launch plan: proven growth tactics, content, social campaigns, KOL outreach, announcements, and growth tactics

  • Working directly with our QuantPilot lead to translate technical product details into clear, compelling messaging that resonates with traders

Driving awareness and early user acquisition for pre and post public launch of QuantPilot

What we're looking for

  • Deep native experience in DeFi and crypto. You already live and breathe this space Strong track record in community building and generating organic buzz on Twitter and other crypto channels

  • Execution-focused mindset. This is a doer role, we need someone who ships quickly and gets things done. Ability to quickly understand and run with our chosen narrative.

  • Comfort working independently while staying tightly aligned with a small core team

We're not looking for a generalist marketer who happens to know a bit about crypto. This role needs someone who already lives in the space and can hit the ground running. The launch is close and there's no ramp-up time. If you've made crypto products take off on Twitter, know how to turn technical AI trading features into stories traders care about, and want to own a high-impact launch end to end, we'd love to talk.

Interested? Send CV and examples of community or launch work you've driven in crypto/DeFi.

Why Join 3Commas.io?

🔧 Impact at Scale

Drive product innovation for a platform used by millions of traders and developers worldwide.

🧭 Strategic Influence

Shape the product roadmap and user experience alongside executive leadership.

🧠 Culture of Growth

Join a passionate, talented team where ideas are valued, and careers are accelerated.

🌍 Global & Remote

Work flexibly from Barcelona, Tallinn, Cyprus — or remotely, in sync with our distributed product and tech teams.

Equal Opportunity Statement

3Commas.io is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity fuels innovation and welcomes applications from individuals of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences — regardless of race, gender, age, religion, disability, or sexual orientation.

jobs.title: SEO Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
3Commas.io is a leading SaaS of cryptocurrency trading since 2017, building the leading automation platform for crypto trading and turning complex markets into simple yet powerful algorithmic strategies.

Our AI-driven bots (DCA, Grid, Signal), deep integrations with TradingView, and a robust API enable traders to automate and optimize across 15+ major exchanges, including Binance, Coinbase, OKX, and Bybit. We serve a global community of individual and institutional traders and developers who rely on our security-first, reliable, and battle-tested infrastructure to run strategies 24/7.

As the Senior SEO Specialist, you will own and execute the full spectrum of our organic acquisition strategy across SEO, LLM optimisation, and CRO. This is both a strategic and hands-on role: you will define the long-term growth vision while directly implementing high-impact initiatives that drive measurable increases in traffic, visibility, and conversions across all 3Commas platforms, including our new project quantpilot.com.

You will lead our organic growth efforts end-to-end — from developing a data-driven SEO roadmap to optimising LLM visibility. Working closely with Product, Content, Data, and Engineering, you will ensure organic channels become a scalable and predictable engine of user acquisition and retention. This role requires deep expertise, a builder mentality, and the ability to execute quickly in a fast-moving crypto environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive SEO strategy aligned with overall marketing and business goals.

  • Lead SEO initiatives across all company platforms, ensuring strong organic growth and visibility.

  • Improve LLM visibility for 3commas.io and quantpilot.com .

  • Conduct keyword research, competitive analysis, and performance audits to identify growth opportunities.

  • Oversee link-building, technical SEO, and on-page optimization for multiple domains and regions (including non-English zones).

  • Collaborate closely with content, product, and analytics teams to ensure SEO best practices are implemented across all marketing channels.

  • Monitor, analyze, and report on SEO performance metrics, providing insights and actionable recommendations.

  • Stay up to date with search engine algorithm changes, trends, and tools to continuously improve performance and maintain competitiveness.

  • Manage and mentor external partners or in-house team members responsible for SEO execution.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in strategic SEO management, preferably in fast-paced digital or tech environments.

  • Strong background in the crypto, trading, or fintech industries — must-have.

  • Proven experience in Organic Growth leadership, including a strong background in SEO, as well as hands-on expertise in CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization).

  • Ability to develop and execute multi-channel organic growth strategies, driving measurable increases in traffic, conversions, and user acquisition.

  • Experience leveraging LLM-based strategies (Large Language Models) to scale and optimize SEO and content workflows — e.g., AI-assisted content generation, keyword clustering, SERP analysis, metadata optimization, and content operations.

  • Deep understanding of search engine algorithms, ranking factors, and industry-standard SEO tools (e.g., Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog).

  • Experience integrating SEO strategies with content marketing, PR, and paid campaigns. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into insights and strategy.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with technical and marketing teams.

  • Self-driven, strategic thinker capable of owning and growing the SEO direction of the company.

Why Join 3Commas.io?

🔧 Impact at Scale

Drive product innovation for a platform used by millions of traders and developers worldwide.

🧭 Strategic Influence

Shape the product roadmap and user experience alongside executive leadership.

🧠 Culture of Growth

Join a passionate, talented team where ideas are valued, and careers are accelerated.

🌍 Global & Remote

Work flexibly from Barcelona, Tallinn, Cyprus — or remotely, in sync with our distributed product and tech teams.

3Commas.io is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity fuels innovation and welcomes applications from individuals of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences — regardless of race, gender, age, religion, disability, or sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Crypto Finance Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
3Commas.io is a leading SaaS of cryptocurrency trading since 2017, building the leading automation platform for crypto trading and turning complex markets into simple yet powerful algorithmic strategies.

Our AI-driven bots (DCA, Grid, Signal), deep integrations with TradingView, and a robust API enable traders to automate and optimize across 15+ major exchanges, including Binance, Coinbase, OKX, and Bybit. We serve a global community of individual and institutional traders and developers who rely on our security-first, reliable, and battle-tested infrastructure to run strategies 24/7.

This is a hands-on role with two clear priorities: keeping crypto financial records accurate and well-controlled, and driving finance processes to be faster and more reliable. Alongside that, you'll own the monthly close coordination and consolidation — with full visibility across the company's financial operations and accountability for accurate reporting across all entities.

Key Responsibilities

Crypto Reporting & Reconciliation

• Coordinate, maintain, and improve crypto data flows across wallets, exchanges, custody providers, digital asset locations, internal finance systems, crypto accounting tools, and accounting records.

• Manage crypto balance and transaction reconciliations across wallets, exchanges, crypto accounting tools, and accounting records.

• Prepare crypto finance reports to support month-end close, management reporting, audits, and internal controls.

Process Improvement & Automation

• Improve, automate, and standardize internal finance systems, reports, reconciliations, and financial data flows.

• Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability across finance processes.

Monthly Close Coordination & Consolidation

• Own the monthly close and consolidation across multiple legal entities — from data validation through to the preparation of consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS.

• Liaise with local chief accountants and external service providers to ensure the close is complete, accurate, and on schedule.

• Support compliance with local accounting, tax, payroll, and reporting requirements across all relevant jurisdictions.

Ad-hoc Support

• Support ad hoc finance, accounting, and crypto operations requests from management and cross-functional teams.

• Prepare one-off analyses, reconciliations, reports, and data extracts as needed for internal decision-making.

What We're Looking For

Experience

• 5+ years in finance, audit, analytics, or financial operations.

• 2–3+ years working directly with crypto finance processes: reconciliations, digital asset accounting, or reporting (strongly preferred).

• Hands-on experience with ERPs, crypto accounting or reporting tools, and analytical platforms.

• Experience working with large, high-volume transaction datasets.

• A track record of automating finance reports or reconciliation workflows is a strong advantage.

Education

• Degree in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field.

• Professional certification (ACCA, CPA, CFA, or equivalent) is a plus.

Skills & Mindset

• Genuine interest in crypto, blockchain, digital assets, and the development of the crypto industry.

• Structured thinking and the ability to present complex data, issues, and conclusions in a clear and practical way.

• Excellent communication skills with a strong sense of ownership over processes from start to finish.

• Fluent English (written and verbal); additional languages are a plus.

🔧 Impact at Scale

Drive product innovation for a platform used by millions of traders and developers worldwide.

🧭 Strategic Influence

Shape the product roadmap and user experience alongside executive leadership.

Join a passionate, talented team where ideas are valued, and careers are accelerated.

jobs.title: IT Operations Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
3Commas.io is a leading SaaS of cryptocurrency trading since 2017, building the leading automation platform for crypto trading and turning complex markets into simple yet powerful algorithmic strategies.

Our AI-driven bots (DCA, Grid, Signal), deep integrations with TradingView, and a robust API enable traders to automate and optimize across 15+ major exchanges, including Binance, Coinbase, OKX, and Bybit. We serve a global community of individual and institutional traders and developers who rely on our security-first, reliable, and battle-tested infrastructure to run strategies 24/7.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on IT Operations Specialist to keep our internal IT running smoothly — from access and accounts to devices, automations, and day-to-day user support. You'll be the go-to person for employees worldwide and a key owner of our internal tooling and processes.

What you'll do

Access & identity management

- Administer Okta, Google Workspace, JumpCloud, Atlassian/Jira, Notion and other internal applications.

- Build and maintain automations for routine internal IT processes.

- Design and deliver workflows for other teams and cross-department needs.

IT on-/off-boarding

- Own the full employee lifecycle: prepare access and equipment for day one, and fully revoke access on departure.

- Manage the equipment lifecycle: ordering, worldwide delivery and return, repairs, and resale, including customs coordination.

- Receive and maintain returned devices.

Device management (MDM / Apple environment)

- Manage devices via MDM; create and maintain policies, commands, and scripts.

- Maintain the Munki / Managed Software Center (internal Self Service "App Store").

- Diagnose and resolve device and on-device service issues.

User support & governance

- Provide technical support to office and remote users through the ticketing system.

- Run monthly checks: Shadow IT, installed-application audits, and Munki updates.

- Reconcile access records against actual application access and support manager-led access reviews.

- Document processes and best practices.

- Support basic security tasks: access control and incidents such as phishing.

Office equipment & vendors

- Set up and maintain office network, printers, video cameras, and monitors.

- Source equipment suppliers, agree terms, and handle configuration requests.

What we're looking for

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
3Commas.io is a leading SaaS of cryptocurrency trading since 2017, building the leading automation platform for crypto trading and turning complex markets into simple yet powerful algorithmic strategies.

Our AI-driven bots (DCA, Grid, Signal), deep integrations with TradingView, and a robust API enable traders to automate and optimize across 15+ major exchanges, including Binance, Coinbase, OKX, and Bybit. We serve a global community of individual and institutional traders and developers who rely on our security-first, reliable, and battle-tested infrastructure to run strategies 24/7.

3commas is looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the product experience across QuantPilot, our AI-powered trading platform. The role covers UX, UI, user research, and design strategy.

You need to understand trading. Whether through professional design work on trading platforms or personal trading experience, you must know what traders care about, how they make decisions, and what builds trust.

What you will own

  • End-to-end product experience from signup through daily usage. Every flow, every interaction, every moment where a user stays or leaves.

  • UX design: user flows, wireframing, prototyping, and interaction design. Simplifying complex workflows so users reach value fast.

  • UI design: high-fidelity visual design, component design, and design system development.

  • User research: usability testing, product data analysis, and turning insights into design decisions.

  • Activation and onboarding: reducing friction in the signup-to-value flow so users hit their first meaningful moment faster.

  • Managing other product designers on the team, including setting direction, reviewing work and raising the standard of design output.

  • Data presentation and trust: designing how we show performance data, risk metrics, and AI-generated results in a way traders trust.

  • Collaboration with product and engineering to challenge decisions and push for simpler flows.

What we are looking for

  • Deep trading knowledge and experience. You have designed trading platforms professionally, or you are an active trader who understands charts, order types, risk management, and portfolio views. This is non-negotiable.

  • Strong across both UX and UI, from research through to polished, pixel-perfect output.

  • Demonstrate creative thinking on simplifying complex AI and data-heavy experiences for traders.

  • Portfolio showing UX improvements and visual design quality. Show us problems you solved, not just screens you designed.

  • Comfort in a fast-moving team where the product strategy is still being shaped.

  • Proficiency in Figma and clear English communication across a distributed team.

The right person for this role is equally strong in UX and UI, has real exposure to trading products, and can work across the full design lifecycle: research, IA, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, testing, and QA. We are looking for someone who shapes what gets built, not someone who waits for a spec and makes it look good.

🔧 Impact at Scale

Drive product innovation for a platform used by millions of traders and developers worldwide.

🧭 Strategic Influence

Shape the product roadmap and user experience alongside executive leadership.

🧠 Culture of Growth

Join a passionate, talented team where ideas are valued, and careers are accelerated.

🌍 Global & Remote
